function.description: Remove single-token liquidity from a Pendle market — burns the market's LP token and returns ONE output token. Works BEFORE AND AFTER expiry: a matured market can still be exited here. LP is not a fixed-rate lock and no longer earns swap fees or rewards after expiry, so there is no reason to hold a matured LP position. Approval-gated; pins the canonical Pendle Router. REQUIRES a fresh matching pendle.lp.quote (direction remove) first.
function.name: pendle__lp__remove

amountIn.description: Amount of the LP token to remove in human-readable units.

chain.description: Chain slug or id — one of Pendle's 11 chains (e.g. 'ethereum', 'arbitrum', 'base', 'bsc').

market.description: The Pendle MARKET (LP) CONTRACT ADDRESS — the LP anchor liquidity is added to or removed from.

tokenOut.description: The output token CONTRACT ADDRESS. Defaults to the market's underlying asset.
